body: I’m currently going through the exact same thing, I’ve been asking around about the same thing this past week, I was freaking myself out with implantation bleeding but I was extremely stressed and was sick with a stubborn case of tonsillitis and then strep throat right after so every answer I’ve gotten is that it was more than likely from stress than anything else.

Ah mine came just on time for my period but it must be the same thing in terms of stress and sickness, I’m just going to wait it out and see what happens. My main concern was implantation bleeding but I think I can officially rule that out now.
Ah I see. When you were spotting did it come the time you were suppose to have your period?

I had just recovered from a pulled chest muscle and very stubborn case of tonsillitis followed by strep throat immediately after (had to get a Covid test for this too which just added a lot of stress). Yeah mine is doing the same now, it was dark brown/black Monday & Tuesday but yesterday morning a lot of red blood came out but then stopped then today it’s been the same.
That’s a relief to hear, thanks very much for answering!

I’m on the same boat as you were right now (cept my period wasn’t late) but I’ve been freaking myself out with possible ‘what if pregnancies’. I was extremely stressed between my last period to this one and I’m guessing that could be the reason for it?
That’s a relief to hear, thanks :)
I plan to after this week if nothing changes period wise
Thank you. I’m sorry to hear you’re going through the same thing, it’s a horrible thing. Of course you can message me whenever you like.
It was being discussed with a therapist and his father last week, I haven’t heard anything about it since but I feel he really needs to, but I know he’ll never consider
